verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms flows have a trigger/action structure (docs-21) but contains no documentation or example specifically describing a webhook trigger that exposes a custom URL to receive external HTTP requests and start a run with the payload; no webhook-specific docs, API endpoint spec, or hands-on confirmation are present. missing for 10: explicit webhook trigger documentation, example of webhook URL generation, confirmation that payload is passed into the flow run, any hands-on/community verification of webhook functionality.
